# Vendored dependencies

## supabase.js

- Package: `@supabase/supabase-js`
- Version: `2.119.0`
- Build: UMD (`dist/umd/supabase.js`)
- Source: https://unpkg.com/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0/dist/umd/supabase.js
- License: MIT

The UMD bundle is vendored so GitHub Pages does not depend on a third-party
JavaScript CDN. The browser still talks directly to the configured Supabase
project for Auth/Postgres.
